rules.outlier: n>=4: keep within [med/3, med*3]; n==1 dropped if >10x ask median (ask n>=3)
rules.mover: med30 vs prior 31-365d, n>=5 each side
rules.mover_bimodal: null if either window max/min>3 or IQR/median>0.6
rules.chase_route: CHASE title -> Chase row only from tier=standard sources, and only if same license AND source base-name tokens (finish/chase words stripped) are a subset of the target name, else excluded
rules.buy: sold sample not two-group (max/min<=3, IQR/median<=0.6); variant/exclusive tokens must match Pop; conf asks only, sold_n>=5, 0.25<=ratio<=0.70, newest conf ask <=180d, conf ask median >=50% of sold median (mismatch guard), box number shared by <30 Pops
rules.conf_ask: conf=true from matcher AND condition New AND first 2 name words in title AND chase rows need CHASE in title AND no variant-word clash (glow/diamond/black light/B&W/etc. not in Pop name); accessory listings (PopShield/protector/pin/keychain) excluded
rules.ambiguous_box: movers/buy suppressed when box blank or shared by >=30 Pops
rules.held_fill: Empty sold cells filled from agreeing workbook, market-pop, or price-history eBay rollups. Empty ask cells filled from workbook retail asks or market-pop asks. Asks are never sold. Ambiguous ids stay in docs/proof/price-match-review.csv.
rules.rematch_high: High-confidence rematch sales in data/rematch-high-2026-10-17.csv are merged into sold medians, deduped by item_id. A Pop whose sold price came only from the held-price fill uses those raw sales instead. Asks stay asks. Reported and curated sales stay reported. 3 or more sales are verified; 1–2 stay few sales.
rules.backup_simple: Sales and listings the current matcher did not attach are added only when the title has Funko and Pop, the box number, and the full character name, and the finish and size words agree. A title that says Chase attaches only to a Chase-tier row (chase_variant, or variant_type Chase). A sale or listing that already matched is left alone. Catalog finish or colour the title lacks, and listings that are exclusive-only commons or one of several rows on a number, are review and not counted. Asks are never sold.
